title: Clean & Fast
description: A lean, no-bloat Fabric optimization modpack with smooth animations, ambient sounds, dynamic lighting, minimap, and shader support. Maximum performance, minimum clutter.
body:
# Clean & Fast

**Maximum performance. Minimum bloat. Everything you actually need.**

A carefully curated Fabric optimization modpack that makes Minecraft run as fast as possible while adding only the essential quality of life features every player wants. No filler mods, no unnecessary extras — just a clean, fast, polished experience.

---

##  Performance

| Mod | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| Sodium + Sodium Extra | Complete rendering engine rewrite |
| Lithium | Game logic, AI, and tick optimization |
| ScalableLux | Modern lighting engine rewrite |
| C2ME | Multithreaded chunk loading |
| FerriteCore | Massive RAM reduction |
| ModernFix | All-in-one bug and performance fixes |
| ImmediatelyFast | HUD, GUI, and text rendering optimization |
| Krypton | Network stack optimization |
| Entity Culling + More Culling | Skip rendering what you can't see |
| Dynamic FPS | Saves resources when minimized |
| Clumps | Groups XP orbs to reduce lag |
| Let Me Despawn | Smarter mob despawning |

---

##  Visuals & Audio

| Mod | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| Iris Shaders + Complementary Reimagined | Beautiful shaders out of the box |
| Fresh Animations + EMF/ETF | Smooth, natural mob animations |
| Not Enough Animations + Better Animations Collection | Improved player and mob animations |
| LambDynamicLights | Dynamic lighting from held items |
| Continuity | Connected textures |
| Dynamic Crosshair | Context-aware crosshair |
| Sound Physics Remastered | Realistic sound echoes and reverb |
| AmbientSounds | Immersive environmental audio |

---

##  Navigation

| Mod | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| Xaero's Minimap + World Map | Lightweight minimap with waypoints and full world map |

---

##  Quality of Life

| Mod | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| Jade | Block/entity info tooltip |
| AppleSkin | Food and saturation display |
| Shulker Box Tooltip | See shulker contents on hover |
| Inventory Profiles Next | One-click inventory sorting |
| Mouse Tweaks | Better inventory interaction |
| Controlling | Searchable keybinds |
| Zoomify | Zoom key |
| Mod Menu | In-game mod configuration |
| Reese's Sodium Options | Better video settings layout |

---

*Built for 1.21.2 on Fabric. More versions coming soon.*
